resources.string: Choose a name and currency for the home you share.
Enter the invitation code shared by someone in your household.
Enter the invitation code you received.
Give your household a name between 2 and 60 characters.
Choose a household, create a new one, or join your people.
This invitation is invalid or has expired.
You are already in this household.
Only household owners can do this.
Choose a nickname between 1 and 80 characters, on one line.
Too many attempts. Wait 15 minutes before trying again.
Share this code with someone joining your household.
Anyone with an active code will need a new one to join this household.
Create a code to invite someone. This replaces any active code.
%1$s will have the same owner permissions as you, including managing members and deleting the household. You stay an owner.
%1$s will remain in the household as a member and lose owner permissions.

%1$s will lose access. Financial history and outstanding balances stay. Existing recurring bills keep running with the same payer and split, including future charges for this person. The shared invitation will be revoked.

You will lose access. Your financial history and outstanding balances stay. Existing recurring bills keep running with the same payer and split, including future charges for you. You will need a new invitation to rejoin.

This permanently deletes this household and its shopping lists, tasks, spending accounts, expenses, payments, history, feeds, invitations and receipt photos. Outstanding balances will be lost too. Your account and other households stay.
Make someone else an owner before leaving.
The current code will stop working. A new code will be valid for 24 hours.
This six-character code can invite several people over the next 24 hours. Owners can revoke or replace it.
This older code cannot be displayed. Replace it to get a new six-character code.
Join my household on Loom with code %1$s. Valid until %2$s.
You no longer have access to this household.
This household or member changed. Refresh and try again.
Make someone else an owner before leaving or removing the last owner.
Type the household name exactly to confirm deletion.
The invitation changed. Refresh before replacing or revoking it.
